QuestInfo.name: [Earth Day] Trash Pickup
QuestInfo.0: Earth Day is here, so of course Cassandra has something for you to do.

QuestInfo.2: You sure did find a ton of trash.

item.0: Really? That's your contribution to saving the planet? You can do better than that, 'hero'.
